destination.name: Nowra
destination.tagline: Shoalhaven's regional town, with a naval aviation museum and gateways to Berry and Seven Mile Beach.
destination.description: Nowra, 160 km south-southwest of Sydney, is the seat and commercial centre of the City of Shoalhaven and had 22,584 residents at the 2021 census. Wikivoyage calls it a service town, good for supplies or a coffee, rather than a scenic one. Visitors use it as a base for the Fleet Air Arm Museum at HMAS Albatross, the heritage village of Berry and the sand walks of Seven Mile Beach National Park.
whyVisit: Explore naval aircraft at Fleet Air Arm Museum
Walk the sands of Seven Mile Beach

goodToKnow.title: Museum opens Friday to Sunday
goodToKnow.detail: The Fleet Air Arm Museum is open Fri–Sun and public holidays, 10:00 AM – 4:00 PM, and entry is free; it sits inside the HMAS Albatross base.

goodToKnow.title: Train ends at Bomaderry
goodToKnow.detail: The line ends at Bomaderry, the twin town across the Shoalhaven River, with no trains south; a local bus runs to Stewart Place in Nowra.

goodToKnow.title: Berry is a short drive north
goodToKnow.detail: Berry has a heritage main street, antiques, a historic museum and the Berry Donut Van; allow time for a stop on the way from Sydney.

destination.bestTimeBlurb: {months} are the warm months for the beaches of the Shoalhaven coast.
